channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Drugs regulator moves import approvals fully online with new rulebook
item.description: Revised CDSCO guidance mandates online applications, stricter registration norms for overseas manufacturers and digital compliance through the SUGAM portal.

item.title: ‘Heroic’: How Virginia teens' high school golf tryouts turned life-saving rescue mission at Lake Culpeper
item.description: The trio of Virginia teenagers jumped into a nearby lake to rescue three people, then earned spots on the golf team, according to officials who are hailing their actions as “heroic.”

item.title: Weather Today LIVE: Rains to continue in Delhi, IMD issues flash flood risk in four states
item.description: Weather Today LIVE: In a forecast valid till 11:30 am on Friday, August 7, the IMD said low to moderate flash flood risk is likely over few watersheds and neighbourhoods of the four Met Sub-divisions during next 24 hours:

item.title: US-Iran war news LIVE: Oil prices continue to rise as Iran attacks 'hostile targets' in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: US-Iran war news LIVE: Oil prices extended gains on reports that Iran attacked “hostile targets” in the Strait of Hormuz, with Tehran seeking to bar US ships from the critical waterway in a deal with Oman. Tune in to Live Mint to catch all the latest US-Iran war-related updates.

item.title: Urad defies El Niño threat: prices seen stable as supply to hold up
item.description: Amid El Niño concerns, urad is emerging as an outlier this kharif season. Higher domestic sowing and adequate imports from its top markets are expected to keep supplies adequate, helping contain food inflation and preventing sharp price increases for urad-made staples such as idlis and dal makhani.

item.title: Donald Trump signs fresh executive orders to limit birthright citizenship in US after Supreme Court pushback
item.description: Trump had called on the US Congress to act after the 30 June setback from the SCOTUS, but on Thursday he opted to sign executives orders instead, which set a policy for the government, but are not as effective as laws passed by the US Congress.

item.title: Indian-origin PhD student Vikram Mubayi found dead after going missing during solo hike in California
item.description: Indian-origin UCSB doctoral student Vikram Mubayi was found dead after going missing during a solo hike in California's Big Pine Lakes area. Authorities said there are no signs of foul play, and the investigation is ongoing.

item.title: Is Kit Connor playing Cyclops? Here's what reports say about Marvel's X-Men reboot
item.description: A new report claims that Heartstopper star Kit Connor had been chosen to play Cyclops in MArvel Studios' upcoming X-Men film, though the studio has not officially confirmed the casting.&nbsp;

item.title: India successfully test-fires nuclear-capable Agni-4 ballistic missile off Odisha coast
item.description: India successfully carried out a user trial of the nuclear-capable Agni-4 ballistic missile off the Odisha coast, validating its operational readiness and reinforcing the country's credible minimum deterrence policy.

item.title: Michigan Says Lettuce Is Now Safe to Eat as Parasite Cases Fall
item.description: Cases of cyclospora parasite infections in Michigan that surged as a result of tainted lettuce are declining, and people can resume normal consumption of leafy greens, the state’s health department said Thursday.

item.title: PM Modi urges people to celebrate National Handloom Day, encourages people to make GRWM videos
item.description: Ahead of National Handloom Day, Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged people to celebrate India's rich handloom heritage by sharing videos featuring their favourite handloom products on social media.

item.title: Google expands Ask Maps in India with major AI-powered overhaul: What's changed
item.description: Google has expanded Ask Maps in India with Hindi language support, live public transport updates and AI-powered personalisation, allowing users to receive more contextual recommendations and real-time travel information.

item.title: Tourist alleges racist treatment in Japan: 'I said I'm from India, she called…' - Video
item.description: According to Anant, police officers arrived at the store shortly after the complaint was made. After assessing the situation and reviewing the video footage, they concluded that he had not done anything wrong.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz deal imminent: Is US prepared to back bigger role for Iran? Explained
item.description: Iran and Oman are close to finalising a temporary agreement on shipping through the Hormuz Strait, with officials from both countries indicating that a deal could be announced soon. US President Donald Trump confirmed that his administration was in contact with Tehran.

item.title: FM Nirmala Sitharaman hits back at Jairam Ramesh over UPI taxation: Social media reacts, ‘When I sell my kidney…’
item.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman responded to Jairam Ramesh's criticism of the Taxation Bill, which proposes changes to UPI transaction rules.&nbsp;

item.title: RBI defers loan recovery norms till Jan as lenders seek more time
item.description: Loan recovery has emerged as a contentious issue in recent years, bringing back memories from the late 2000s, when private banks used coercive tactics for the process.

item.title: Dabur moves Delhi HC against FSSAI order banning '100%' claims on honey, ghee and other products
item.description: Dabur India has moved the Delhi High Court against the FSSAI's order banning the sale of products carrying 100% claims. The company alleged the regulator acted without issuing a show-cause notice or giving it an opportunity to be heard.

item.title: Lok Sabha passes tax amendments, Rajya Sabha clears extra FY26 spending
item.description: The twin legislative moves streamline India’s direct tax and payments framework while granting statutory backing for additional government expenditure in FY26.

item.title: Paradise teaser: Nani returns in gritty avatar as Srikanth Odela unveils dark revenge drama
item.description: The teaser of The Paradise has been released, offering a dark first look at Nani’s upcoming film with director Srikanth Odela. The action-packed preview confirms a September 24, 2026 theatrical release.

item.title: Rahul Gandhi backs Jharkhand protest over job exam row: 'Every Govt must listen to students'
item.description: Every government, be it the Central government, Jharkhand government or a Congress government, should listen to what students are saying and take action to change the education system, said Rahul Gandhi.

item.title: ‘Toughest for me’: Father reveals strict stance for daughter while sending her to hostel; LinkedIn reacts
item.description: Rohit Gupta shared an emotional LinkedIn post explaining his decision to stop communicating with his daughter for two weeks after dropping her off at boarding school.&nbsp;

item.title: India rules out ethanol import concessions to US, says no policy change in bilateral trade talks
item.description: India mandates mixing 20% ethanol with gasoline. Government regulations allow the use of locally produced ethanol for mixing with gasoline.

item.title: 'Gen Z protesters not anti-national': RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat backs dialogue, calls education grievances ‘genuine’
item.description: Bhagwat's interaction is being seen as the RSS' most significant outreach to Gen Z and Gen Alpha since the Cockroach Janta Party's (CJP) protests over NEET paper leak culminated in Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation.

item.title: CJP forms National Working Committee, appoints Abhijeet Dipke as national convener | Full list
item.description: A day after deciding to remain a public pressure group, the Cockroach Janta Party formed its first National Working Committee, appointing founder Abhijeet Dipke as national convener and announcing a nationwide organisational expansion plan.

item.title: Delhi-based CEO who hired Gen Z candidate despite him refusing to work Saturdays says, ‘He outperformed everyone’
item.description: Abhishek Agarwal shared how an interview with a 25-year-old candidate turned into a discussion about work-life balance and completely changed his initial impression.

item.title: 'I am one of them': Tarun Tejpal reacts to rape conviction, likens himself to Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam
item.description: Convicted in the 2013 rape case, Tarun Tejpal claimed he was being targeted out of political vendetta, likened his situation to that of Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam, and said he would challenge the verdict in the Supreme Court.&nbsp;

item.title: PM Modi receives call from Israeli counterpart Netanyahu, discusses West Asia crisis
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Thursday received a telephone call from his Israeli counterpart Benjamin Netanyahu and they discussed the West Asia crisis.

item.title: Cabinet clears ₹23.7k-crore GOBARdhan ‘waste-to-energy’ biogas scheme
item.description: The ₹23,731-crore GOBARdhan scheme marks a shift from piecemeal incentives to a full-market framework for compressed biogas. By guaranteeing demand and supporting production as well as investment, India looks to create a ₹75,000-crore industry while reducing gas imports.

item.title: US Senate panel votes to hold Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress over Covid hearing testimony
item.description: A US Senate committee voted to hold Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress after he repeatedly invoked the Fifth Amendment during a Covid-19 hearing. The matter will now be referred to the Justice Department.

item.title: Kochi-bound flight passenger arrested for trying to open emergency exit mid-air
item.description: The FIR alleged that Athanikkal tried to force open the aircraft's emergency exit, damaged its window panel and threatened fellow passengers, putting the safety of everyone on board at risk.

item.title: Brij Bhushan Singh gets grand welcome in Gonda with ‘Sher aaya’ chants, flower petals after acquittal in wrestlers' case
item.description: Brij Bhushan Singh reached Ayodhya's international airport in a chartered aircraft, where supporters greeted him with drums, music and chants. Thousands of supporters gathered along the route from the airport, with flower petals showered on his convoy.

item.title: Maharashtra doctors call off strike after HC order: Why they protested, allopathy vs homeopathy explained
item.description: Maharashtra resident doctors have called off their strike after the Bombay High Court's intervention, but the row over allowing qualified homeopathy practitioners to prescribe allopathic medicines continues. Here's why doctors protested and how the rules differ for ayurvedic practitioners.

item.title: Tata Motors, Mahindra beat Tesla-BYD to top global EV ranking: Social media quips, ‘Alto more efficient than Ferrari’
item.description: Indian EV manufacturers Tata Motors and Mahindra topped a global energy-efficiency ranking, surpassing 20 other automakers, including Tesla and BYD.&nbsp;

item.title: Daughters attend Mumbai-based businessman's funeral via video call, transfer ₹5,000 for cremation expenses | Viral clip
item.description: The clip, which is now doing the rounds on social media, shows one of the daughters asking whether all the rituals had been performed properly and requesting that the recording be sent to her.

item.title: ₹550 crore spent on PM Modi's foreign trips since 2021; ₹74.5 crore in 2026 so far: Govt in Parliament
item.description: According to the reply by MEA, expenditure on the Prime Minister's foreign visits was over ₹180 crore in 2025, ₹109 crore in 2024, ₹93 crore in 2023, ₹55 crore in 2022 and ₹36 crore in 2021.
